title: Austin Budget Policy & Strategic Goals
summary:
*   **Budget Worksession Dominates**: The meeting was solely dedicated to a comprehensive worksession on the city's 1991-92 Budget Policy.
*   **Departmental Deep Dive**: Council members reviewed the budgets for numerous critical city departments, including public safety (Police, Fire, EMS), health, utilities (Electric, Water, Wastewater), parks, and public works.
*   **Strategic Planning Discussed**: There was a discussion about the city's strategic goals, with plans to vote on the 1991-92 goals the following day.
*   **Key Decisions Postponed**: Several important actions, such as approving the budget process, council committee assignments, and the new strategic goals, were deferred to the next day's regular meeting.
transcript:
POUNDED 1.9
Austin City Council
MINUTES
June 19, 1991
-
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
TOWN LAKE CENTER 8:30 Α.Μ.
-
Mayor Todd called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence
of Mayor Pro Tem Urdy. The Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a
worksession on Budget Policy 1991-92.
City Manager Barnette began the discussion by referring Council to the Policy Budget for
1991-92 and highlighted her transmittal letter. A copy of the Policy Budget is on file in
the City Clerk's Office. : The following departments were reviewed in the morning: Public
Information Office, General Services Department, Health, Brackenridge Hospital, Police,
Fire, Emergency Medical Service.
Council recessed from 11:32 to 1:35 P.M. for lunch.
Departments reviewed in the afternoon were: Electric, Water and Vastewater, Parks/Library,
Public Works and Environment.
Strategic Goals were discussed concerning status of goals adopted by the City Council on
October 11, 1990 and discussion on goals for current Council.
It was decided the current goals would be voted upon at the regular Council meeting of
June 20, 1991.
Also postponed to June 20, 1991 were the following action items: Approve City Council
Committee Assignments
Approval of budget process and schedule
Approve Resolution adopting 1991-92 Goals.
The Executive Session which would provide directions to the City Manager was postponed to
June 20, 1991.
The meeting was adjourned at 4:45 P.M. on Councilmember Epstein's motion, Councilmember
Reynolds' second, 6-0 Vote, Mayor Pro Tem Urdy absent. MINUTES
